user.title: AwoX / EGLO connect mesh
user.description: The mesh credentials can be fetched once from your AwoX account, or typed in. After setup everything runs locally over Bluetooth.

menu_options.cloud: Log in to my AwoX account (once)

cloud.title: AwoX account
cloud.description: Used once to read the mesh name, password and device list. Your account password is not stored.

manual.title: Mesh credentials
manual.description: Home Assistant connects to the light with this MAC address and lists every node that answers.

error.device_not_found: No connectable Bluetooth device with this MAC address is in range of an adapter or proxy
error.no_status: Logged in, but no light answered the status request

abort.no_devices_found: No AwoX mesh device in this account

init.title: Local Bluetooth adapter
init.description: These lights break Home Assistant's local Bluetooth stack (BlueZ) when notifications are enabled. ESPHome Bluetooth proxies are not affected and always get instant state updates.

options.stable: Stable link: instant commands, no updates for changes made in the AwoX app
options.cycle: Push updates: changes from the app show up, but the link restarts every ~27 s (commands can wait up to ~25 s)
